title: Using secrets in an if condition fails with "Unrecognized named-value: 'secrets'"
symptoms: Unrecognized named-value: 'secrets'. Located at position 1 within expression
Workflow is invalid before it runs
An if condition that reads secrets.TOKEN is never evaluated
cause: The secrets context is not allowed in jobs.ID.if or in step if conditions. Only contexts listed for each key are available there.
fix: Map the secret into env at job level and test env in the step condition.
apply:
jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      HAS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN != '' }}
    steps:
      - if: env.HAS_TOKEN == 'true'
        run: npm publish
affected: GitHub Actions workflow syntax, as of October 2026
